tools.community_coming_soon: More fun tools are coming soon
tools.recall_relations_tooltip: Look up people, places, or events: search entities, list neighbors, or follow relation paths with diary excerpts. Read-only.
tools.recall_relations_desc: Query entities, neighbors, paths, or timeline in the personal memory graph (read-only).
tools.graph_upsert_tooltip: Write people, places, events, and relations to the life graph. Changes take effect immediately. An exact same name updates that node and does not merge two nodes. Existing relations can be edited or removed. Merge nodes yourself on the graph page.
tools.graph_upsert_desc: Create, update, or remove entities and relations in the personal life graph.
tools.current_time_tooltip: Lets the partner call a tool to get the real-world date and time. Always available and cannot be disabled.
tools.web_search_tooltip: Search the public web for current news and facts—not personal diaries. When disabled, the partner cannot use web search (the per-session toolbar toggle is separate).
tools.web_search_not_enabled: Web search not enabled. Please enable it in the toolbar.
tools.param_max_results_desc: Maximum number of results returned per AI search
tools.param_max_results_tooltip: Limits how many diary search hits are returned in one query.
tools.diary_read_tooltip: Lets the partner read full diary entries by date. Up to 20 entries per call; pass exact dates (use List or Search Diaries first if unknown).
tools.diary_write_tooltip: Create a new diary entry for a given date. If an entry already exists for that date, use diary_edit instead.
tools.diary_edit_tooltip: Edit an existing diary—append by default; full overwrite only when the user explicitly requests it.
tools.diary_delete_tooltip: Permanently delete a diary entry. This cannot be undone.
tools.diary_list_tooltip: List diary dates in a range with short previews.
tools.diary_search_tooltip: Keyword search across your personal diaries (not the public internet).
tools.summary_read_tooltip: Read AI-generated weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly summaries, or detect missing summaries.
tools.summary_write_tooltip: Write or update weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly summaries.
tools.message_search_tooltip: Search past chat messages by keyword, or list original messages in a date range without a keyword.
tools.session_list_tooltip: List conversations that have messages in a local date range, with title, time, and a short preview.
tools.memory_store_tooltip: Save important facts to long-term memory for later semantic recall.
tools.memory_delete_tooltip: Remove a stored memory by its unique id. Confirm with the user before deleting.
tools.auto_inject_time_desc: Show the partner when messages were sent and your timezone
tools.auto_inject_time_tooltip: When enabled, the partner can see when each message was sent and your timezone. Some models may copy those time tags into replies. When disabled, time is not added automatically; the partner can use Get Current Time if needed.
tools.auto_inject_time_enable_confirm: When this is on, each history message sent to the partner includes a send-time tag. Some models may copy those tags into replies, so the chat bubble may show text like <message-time>. Turn it on anyway?
tools.param_search_engine_desc: Select the engine used for web search
tools.url_read_tooltip: Read the text content of a specific webpage URL when you already have a link to analyze.
tools.param_max_length_desc: Maximum characters returned when reading a web page
tools.param_rag_enabled_desc: When enabled, search results are filtered by relevance via vector retrieval (requires an embedding model)
tools.param_rag_max_chunks_desc: Maximum number of extracted chunks to provide to the AI as reference, determining the upper limit of token consumption
tools.param_rag_chunks_per_source_desc: Maximum number of chunks extracted from a single website, preventing a long article from dominating the results
tools.param_plain_snippet_length_desc: When an Embedding model is not configured, the system falls back to concatenating the raw text. To avoid consuming too many Tokens, text will be truncated per site after this length
tools.param_tavily_api_key_desc: Tavily search API key (get free at https://app.tavily.com)
tools.param_exa_api_key_desc: Exa search API key (get at https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys)

shortcuts.translate_content: Please translate the following text into English faithfully and elegantly (including explanations of professional terms):
shortcuts.summarize_content: Please summarize the core meaning behind the following content:

tools.web_search_desc: Search the public internet for up-to-date news, facts, and real-time information.
tools.vector_search_desc: Semantic and hybrid (vector + keyword) search across personal diary entries, conversation history, and stored memories.
tools.url_read_desc: Fetch and read the main text content of a specific webpage URL.
tools.summary_read_desc: Read AI-generated period summaries (weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly).
tools.message_search_desc: Search past conversation messages by keyword or date range.
tools.session_list_desc: List conversations active within a date range with titles and short previews.
tools.memory_store_desc: Store important facts or preferences into long-term vector memory.
tools.memory_delete_desc: Delete a stored long-term memory entry by its unique ID.
tools.diary_write_desc: Create a new diary entry for a given date.
tools.diary_search_desc: Search local personal diary entries by exact keyword (FTS5). For semantic search over diaries, use Semantic Search.
tools.diary_read_desc: Read full diary entries by exact dates (up to 20 per call).
tools.diary_list_desc: List diary dates and short previews within a date range.
tools.diary_edit_desc: Append to or overwrite an existing diary entry for a given date.
tools.diary_delete_desc: Permanently delete a diary entry for a specific date.
tools.current_time_desc: Get the current real-world date, time, weekday, and timezone.
tools.emoji_send_desc: Send a sticker image in the chat when it fits the conversation.
tools.emoji_frequency_hint_low: Only send stickers occasionally, when they fit especially well
tools.emoji_frequency_hint_normal: Send stickers when they fit the mood, but not in every reply
tools.emoji_frequency_hint_high: Most replies will include a sticker
tools.emoji_frequency_hint_always: Include one sticker in every reply (still at most one)
tools.emoji_settings_help: When enabled, companions can send your uploaded stickers in chat based on context. Create sticker groups and upload images below, then enable and select groups for each companion in companion settings.
tools.emoji_groups_empty: No sticker groups yet. Tap "New group" to get started.
tools.emoji_groups_hint: Configure separate sticker groups for different companions
tools.emoji_group_delete_confirm: Delete sticker group "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
tools.emoji_no_groups: Create a sticker group in Sticker settings first
tools.compress_context_upstream_desc: Merge earlier dialogue into a rolling summary before the next model request (upstream).
tools.compress_context_downstream_desc: Refresh the summary and prune long tool outputs after the assistant reply is saved (downstream).
tools.companion_ask_desc: Ask the user a clarifying question with optional choices; blocks until the user responds.
tools.companion_ask_tooltip: Ask the user a clarifying question with optional choices; blocks until the user responds.
tools.workspace_list_tooltip: List files and folders inside the workspace.
tools.workspace_read_tooltip: Read a text file from the workspace.
tools.workspace_write_tooltip: Create or overwrite a text file in the workspace.
tools.workspace_patch_tooltip: Apply a targeted text replacement in a workspace file.
tools.workspace_rename_tooltip: Rename or move a file within the workspace.
tools.workspace_delete_tooltip: Delete a file in the workspace.
tools.workspace_run_tooltip: Run a host command in the workspace; no OS sandbox; ask each time.
tools.skill_write_tooltip: Create or update a software-level skill in the user home skill directory. Asks before each save by default.
tools.skill_read_desc: List available skills or read the SKILL.md workflow instructions for a specific skill.
tools.skill_read_tooltip: List available skills or read the SKILL.md workflow instructions for a specific skill.
tools.knowledge_search_desc: Search mounted knowledge notebooks with hybrid vector and full-text retrieval to return relevant source excerpts. Read-only.
tools.knowledge_search_tooltip: Search mounted knowledge notebooks with hybrid vector and full-text retrieval to return relevant source excerpts. Read-only.
tools.knowledge_graph_search_desc: Search entities and relationships extracted from mounted knowledge notebooks. Read-only and isolated from the personal life graph.
tools.knowledge_graph_search_tooltip: Search entities and relationships extracted from mounted knowledge notebooks. Read-only and isolated from the personal life graph.
tools.skill_writer_unavailable: Skill writer is not available in this environment.
tools.playful_process_status_desc: Show playful daily status at the top of the companion process section
tools.playful_process_status_help: When enabled, the top of the companion process section rotates playful daily statuses like 'Companion is sipping tea…' during thinking and tool calls. Turn off to use classic status labels.

agent_workspace.pick_workspace_hint: Select or add a workspace first

agent_workspace.input_placeholder: Describe the changes you want in this folder…

agent_gate.coalesce_hint: {{count}} more similar access(es) in this turn will be allowed together
